trust_decision.summary: Which file the unauthenticated info-window AJAX request may require: the client-posted form array supplies info_window_template.content_path and the component/prefix identity, and each component loader decides by a realpath prefix test against its templates dir or the child theme's geo-my-wp dir; when the theme dir is missing, realpath() returns false so the base becomes the bare directory separator and every absolute path passes; the unvalidated raw path is then required.

landing_point.why: gmw_ajax_info_window_init is the wp_ajax_nopriv_gmw_info_window_init handler (includes/gmw-functions.php:1988) that takes $_POST['form'] verbatim; a summary saying 'unauthenticated LFI' leads to the nopriv AJAX hook first.

fix_sites.entry_point: admin-ajax.php action=gmw_info_window_init (nopriv): form source selection and stored-form identity override (fix.diff:106-153)
new shared validator gmw_validate_ajax_info_window_template_path, called from the dispatcher and both loaders (fix.diff:48-97)
gmw_posts_locator_ajax_info_window_loader, dispatched by name from includes/gmw-functions.php:1973-1976 when component=posts_locator
gmw_members_locator_ajax_info_window_loader, dispatched by name from includes/gmw-functions.php:1973-1976 when component=members_locator (BuddyPress)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: plugins/members-locator/includes/gmw-members-locator-functions.php:161-172 (a second copy of the same check and require in the BuddyPress members add-on, separate from the posts loader at plugins/posts-locator/includes/gmw-posts-locator-functions.php:964-975)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The members loader only runs when BuddyPress is active and bp_has_members() finds the member (plugins/members-locator/includes/gmw-members-locator-functions.php:109-118), so a solver who reproduced through posts_locator can call it a separate optional integration; and a fix limited to the loaders leaves the dispatcher trusting the posted component/prefix (includes/gmw-functions.php:1973).

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Custom info-window templates must keep loading from the child theme, the parent theme (get_template_directory()/geo-my-wp) and a filter-supplied custom path. The pre-fix check already rejected parent-theme templates that the template producer returns, and a strict plugin-dir-only allowlist breaks all theme overrides.

O6_input_shapes: form posted as an array carrying content_path (fix.diff:117-120)
form posted as a non-array or missing, which falls back to the stored form plus rebuilt template data (fix.diff:123-126)
form_id missing or invalid, now rejected with 400 (fix.diff:107-115)
posted identity keys ID/slug/addon/component/prefix/object_type overridden by the stored form (fix.diff:129-137)
content_path that is not a string, does not exist, is not readable or is not .php (fix.diff:50-58)
symlink or ../ path resolved with realpath before the prefix test, and the canonical path is required instead of the raw one (fix.diff:54, fix.diff:169-180)
allowed directory that does not exist is skipped instead of collapsing to '/' (fix.diff:83-87)
prefix test with a trailing slash, so a sibling directory with the same name prefix does not match (fix.diff:89-91)

O7_producer.where: includes/class-gmw-helper.php:235-322 (GMW_Helper::get_template builds content_path from component plugin_dir, child or parent theme, and the gmw_get_template_path_uri filter), reached via includes/template-functions/gmw-template-functions.php:245-256

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A third component loader or a gmw_{component}_pre_ajax_info_window_init / _ajax_info_window_init listener (for example in global-maps or a groups locator) that requires $gmw['info_window_template']['content_path'] with its own copy of the prefix check.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The dispatcher calls loaders and hooks by component name (includes/gmw-functions.php:1964, 1973-1983), and each existing component carries its own copied check (posts and members loaders), so a further add-on with a copied check fits the codebase's pattern.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An AJAX-results variant that builds results_template.content_path from posted form data and includes it with '. single-result.php' appended.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The AJAX form submission is nopriv (includes/class-gmw-form-core.php:1350-1376) and the results include already concatenates a path from the form array, so a maintainer adding a 'use posted runtime form data' shortcut there would copy the info-window design.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A template_name containing '../' after the 'custom_' prefix is stripped, then joined into content_path.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The producer concatenates template_name into the path with no separator check; it is safe today only because the names come from stored admin settings.

O9_family: Local file inclusion (CWE-98): client-supplied template path reaches PHP require; path-prefix allowlist defeated by realpath(false) on a missing directory

O10_build.toolchain: WordPress plugin (PHP >= 7.0, WordPress >= 5.6); composer.json and package.json present for dev tooling only
O10_build.project_tests: none: the pinned tree has no tests/ directory and no phpunit config.

j.j_sites_touched: includes/gmw-functions.php, plugins/posts-locator/includes/gmw-posts-locator-functions.php, plugins/members-locator/includes/gmw-members-locator-functions.php (plus version bumps in geo-my-wp.php and readme.txt)
j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Patch the posts loader's prefix check, or require only the realpath, and leave the members loader, the missing-theme-dir '/' collapse, and the dispatcher's trust in the posted form/component untouched.

out_of_scope_notes: includes/location-form/includes/class-gmw-location-form.php:1405 includes a path built from args['form_template']; this is a different feature (location form), and its args source was not traced.
includes/class-gmw-form-core.php:336-342 builds a require_once path from the stored form's slug/addon; it uses stored admin data, not this advisory's request input.
